title: News: Richmond draft budget proposes property tax hike
context: You will hear a local radio news report about the City of Richmond's draft budget.

segments.speaker: News reader
segments.text: Homeowners in Richmond are being told to brace for another sizeable jump in their property tax bill. The city's draft budget, released this morning, calls for an increase of six point eight percent next year, which works out to roughly two hundred and ten dollars for the average home.

segments.speaker: News reader
segments.text: Finance director Wei Ling Tran says most of that increase isn't new spending. More than half covers wage increases for firefighters and police that were negotiated last year, and another chunk comes from the rising cost of insurance and fuel. The only significant new item is the hiring of six bylaw officers to work through a backlog of complaints about illegal suites and noise.

segments.speaker: News reader
segments.text: Council is divided. Councillor Aaron Fitzgerald says residents are already stretched thin by grocery and mortgage costs, and he plans to push for the bylaw hires to be phased in over two years, which would shave about one percentage point off the increase. Councillor Nadia Sorensen counters that complaints have doubled since 2023, and that putting off enforcement would only kick the problem down the road.

segments.speaker: News reader
segments.text: The city is also reminding seniors and people with disabilities that they may qualify for the provincial property tax deferment program, which lets eligible homeowners postpone paying until they sell their home.

segments.speaker: News reader
segments.text: Residents can comment on the draft budget online until December twelfth. Council will vote on the final version in late January.

questions.prompt: According to Wei Ling Tran, what is mainly behind the increase?

options.text: Costs the city had already committed to
options.whyVi: Đúng: hơn một nửa là tăng lương đã thương lượng từ năm ngoái, cộng với bảo hiểm và nhiên liệu – không phải chi tiêu mới.

options.text: Hiring more police officers and firefighters
options.whyVi: Bài có 'firefighters and police' nhưng là tăng lương cho người hiện có, không phải tuyển thêm.

options.text: Several new programs for residents
options.whyVi: Ngược lại: bà nói phần lớn mức tăng 'isn't new spending'.

options.text: The cost of the six new bylaw officers
options.whyVi: Đây là khoản mới duy nhất, nhưng không phải phần lớn mức tăng.

questions.evidence: More than half covers wage increases for firefighters and police that were negotiated last year
questions.explanationVi: Ý chính: 'most of that increase isn't new spending' và lương 'negotiated last year'. Đáp án A khái quát thành 'costs already committed to'.

questions.prompt: What are the new bylaw officers expected to do?

options.text: Inspect homes for insurance purposes
options.whyVi: Bài có 'insurance' nhưng nói về chi phí bảo hiểm tăng.

options.text: Collect unpaid property taxes
options.whyVi: Bài không nói nhân viên bylaw thu thuế.

options.text: Patrol the city for parking violations
options.whyVi: Bài không nhắc tới đỗ xe.

options.text: Deal with a build-up of unresolved complaints
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'work through a backlog of complaints' = giải quyết khiếu nại tồn đọng.

questions.evidence: to work through a backlog of complaints about illegal suites and noise
questions.explanationVi: Cần biết 'backlog' = việc tồn đọng. Đáp án D diễn đạt lại 'work through a backlog' thành 'deal with a build-up of unresolved complaints'.

questions.prompt: What does Councillor Fitzgerald want to do?

options.text: Cancel the bylaw officer positions completely
options.whyVi: Quá mức: ông chỉ muốn chia ra hai năm, không hủy hẳn.

options.text: Cut the raises negotiated for police
options.whyVi: Ông không đề xuất cắt tăng lương.

options.text: Spread the new hires out to ease the burden on taxpayers
options.whyVi: Đúng: tuyển dần trong hai năm để giảm khoảng 1 điểm phần trăm, vì người dân đang chật vật.

options.text: Limit the tax increase to one percent
options.whyVi: Sai số liệu: giảm BỚT khoảng 1 điểm phần trăm (từ 6,8%), không phải giới hạn ở 1%.

questions.evidence: he plans to push for the bylaw hires to be phased in over two years
questions.explanationVi: 'phased in over two years' được diễn đạt lại thành 'spread the new hires out'; 'stretched thin' (chật vật về tài chính) giải thích lý do. Lựa chọn D bẫy với con số 'one percentage point'.

options.text: Complaints have dropped since 2023.
options.whyVi: Ngược lại: số khiếu nại đã tăng gấp đôi.

options.text: Delaying enforcement would only push the problem into the future.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'kick the problem down the road' = đẩy vấn đề sang sau.

options.text: Residents cannot afford a larger tax increase.
options.whyVi: Đây là lập luận của Fitzgerald.

options.text: The officers should be hired gradually over two years.
options.whyVi: Đây là đề xuất của Fitzgerald, bà phản đối điều này.

questions.evidence: putting off enforcement would only kick the problem down the road
questions.explanationVi: 'counters' cho thấy bà phản bác Fitzgerald. Thành ngữ 'kick the problem down the road' = trì hoãn vấn đề thay vì giải quyết.
vocabulary: kick the problem down the road

questions.prompt: What is true about the property tax deferment program?

options.text: It reduces property taxes for all seniors.
options.whyVi: Sai: chương trình cho hoãn trả, không giảm thuế, và chỉ dành cho người đủ điều kiện.

options.text: It is run by the City of Richmond.
options.whyVi: Sai: đây là chương trình của tỉnh ('provincial').

options.text: Qualifying owners can delay payment until their property is sold.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'postpone paying until they sell their home'.

options.text: Applications must be made by December twelfth.
options.whyVi: Ngày 12/12 là hạn góp ý ngân sách, không liên quan chương trình hoãn thuế.

questions.evidence: lets eligible homeowners postpone paying until they sell their home
questions.explanationVi: 'eligible' = 'qualifying', 'postpone' = 'delay', 'sell their home' = 'property is sold'. Cả câu được diễn đạt lại.

vocabulary.example: Homeowners should brace for a higher tax bill.
Another chunk of the increase comes from fuel costs.

vocabulary.definition: a build-up of work that has not been done yet
vocabulary.example: There is a backlog of noise complaints.

vocabulary.definition: having almost no money or resources left
vocabulary.example: Families are stretched thin by grocery costs.

vocabulary.definition: introduce something gradually over a period
vocabulary.example: The hires could be phased in over two years.

vocabulary.term: kick the problem down the road
vocabulary.vi: trì hoãn giải quyết vấn đề
vocabulary.definition: delay dealing with a problem instead of solving it
vocabulary.example: Putting off enforcement would only kick the problem down the road.

vocabulary.definition: an arrangement to do or pay something later
vocabulary.example: The tax deferment program helps seniors.

review.notes: Solved all 5 independently; keys match (ADCBC); the provincial property tax deferment description (eligible owners, incl. seniors and people with disabilities, defer until sale) is accurate. Tightened Q4 correct option so it no longer adds an unstated claim ("make it harder later").
